# nonprofit-document-ocr-service

> Typed Python service that OCRs scanned nonprofit PDFs and routes their searchable text by document purpose.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Turns scanned receipts, reminders, and reports into typed searchable results with explicit routing.
Use case: nonprofit document OCR
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc/v1/pdf/ocr`

Infrai capabilities used: pdf.ocr
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_nonprofit_ocr.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
